data.name: Murshida
data.gender_notes: Murshida is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root sh-r-d, meaning to guide, Murshida is a name for a woman who acts as a guide or helper, a spiritual mentor. In Islamic tradition, Murshida is a title given to Sufi women who serve as spiritual teachers and guides to other women. The name Murshida carries the meaning “Guide, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murshida usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Murshida belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murshida total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
